consumerClasses.reason: Card header and footer pad only when given Tailwind's border-b or border-t, which no element carries here.

coverageExclusions.attachment: AttachmentTrigger's type default when given a render element is a branch the docs example never takes.
coverageExclusions.drawer: DrawerContent marks snap points only when given snapPoints, which the docs example never passes as a literal.
coverageExclusions.field: FieldError's handling of an errors list (none, one, or several with duplicates) is logic no render the docs example makes reaches.
coverageExclusions.input-group: InputGroupAddon focuses the input when clicked outside a button: an interaction, not a render.
coverageExclusions.input-otp: InputOTPSlot's fake caret shows only while the input has focus, and its fallback for a missing OTPInput context only outside InputOTP; the docs example renders neither.
coverageExclusions.slider: Slider's branch for a controlled value needs a literal value, which the docs example never passes.

globalClasses.reason: shadcn's dark variant: apps toggle it on <html>.
Field sizes a visually hidden child, marked with the common sr-only class, to fit.

classesWithoutCss.reason: NavigationMenuContent: `data-activation-direction=left:` is not a Tailwind variant (it needs data-[activation-direction=left]:).
NavigationMenu's popup: easing-* is not a Tailwind utility, and the theme defines no xs breakpoint.

testSetup.reason: jsdom has no ResizeObserver or scrollIntoView, which cmdk uses to track and reveal the selected item.

unrenderedInTests.NavigationMenuPositioner: Base UI mounts it only while a menu item is open, which takes the item's value on NavigationMenu.
